newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's 30-year bond yield hits 7.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's 30-year bond yield hits 7.0 pct.

text.p: Treasury's 30-year bond jumped to 7.0 percent on Thursday morning, the highest since the April 28 closing level.

The move was technically driven, analysts said, as large hedge funds were engaged in curve-flattening trades following the Federal Reserve's leaving monetary policy unchanged at its meeting on Tuesday.
The yield has since dropped below 7.0 percent to 6.98 percent.
